newsitem.title: USA: Vitech America names Edward Kelly CFO.
newsitem.headline: Vitech America names Edward Kelly CFO.

text.p: MIAMI, June 20 ( Reuter) - Vitech America Inc said Friday it had named Edward Kelly, formerly corporate controller of Vitech, as chief financial officer.
Kelly replaces Mitchell Asher, who will continue his role in the areas of strategic planning and new business development, the company said.
Vitech is a U.S.-based direct marketer of personal computers, servers and networking equipment in Brazil.
